articles.title: Git for the US Code
articles.summary: The US code is a complex system of record that can be difficult for lawyers to navigate due to the lack of a clear lineage of a law. This is particularly relevant when language models are used for first-pass legal research, as they often struggle to understand the proper lineage of a law. The Office of the Law Revision Counsel publishes the US code as a series of release points, but the definition of a small business debtor in 11 USC § 1182(1) shows how far apart those answers can be, with the limit being increased and then restored over time. This lack of clarity can lead to errors in interpretation, as language models may apply newer provisions even when the facts of the case are governed by an older law.

The vulnerability, with a severity rating of 9.5 out of 10, resides in the UEFI firmware used by most of the world's server vendors and data centers, and is particularly concerning due to its ability to execute malicious code before the operating system and firmware can implement defenses like Secure Boot. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-97631, can be exploited by attackers to install other payloads that run each time the boot process occurs, giving them a wide opening to install additional malicious code.

articles.summary: Project Zero compared two automated tools used by Google to find vulnerabilities in Chrome's JavaScript engine, V8, on a regular basis. Fuzzilli is a generative JavaScript engine fuzzer and BigSleep is an LLM-based bug finding system. BigSleep found more vulnerabilities than Fuzzilli with a 25% overlap in the specific bugs reported. The comparison methodology underestimated overlap, and experiments estimated overlap at roughly 60%. Fuzzing and LLMs are complementary approaches, but LLMs have become able to find many vulnerabilities quickly, and vendors should perform both fuzzing and agentic analysis of their code to maximize the number of vulnerabilities reported.

The core of the technique involves using a floodfill algorithm to fill in the missing areas with a specified color or pattern. The algorithm starts from a given point and iteratively fills in the surrounding areas with the same color or pattern. The technique is often used in conjunction with other image processing techniques, such as thresholding and edge detection, to enhance the quality of the image.

articles.title: Compile-Time Dependent Types
articles.summary: Compile-time dependent types are a feature that has been explored in various programming languages, including C++, Rust, Zig, and C. These features aim to encode compile-time computation in a type system, but they often lack a proper type system or are highly restricted. The Syl language, which is being developed, is one such example, and it uses modes to describe properties of values independent of their types. Modes can be used to indicate whether a value is static or dynamic, and they have a sub-moding relation that can be used to weaken or strengthen the mode. This allows for more flexibility in programming, but also introduces new challenges, such as the ability to branch on dynamic values and the need to preserve staticity in functions.
